<!-- SELF-CONTAINED VERSION: all campaign images and newspaper are embedded in this HTML file. -->
<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" name="viewport"/>
<meta content="Meet Kelly Hamilton, candidate for Waterford Board of Education. Learn about her Waterford roots, community involvement, upcoming events, ideas and voter information." name="description"/>
<title>Kelly Hamilton | Waterford Board of Education</title>
<style>
    :root{
      --navy:#07375f; --navy2:#0c2944; --teal:#29bfd0; --teal2:#62dbe6;
      --ink:#172b3a; --muted:#5f7180; --cream:#f5f0e8; --paper:#fffdfa;
      --line:#d9e3e8; --soft:#eef8f9; --white:#fff;
    }
    *{box-sizing:border-box} html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
    body{margin:0;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:#f7f9fa;line-height:1.55}
    img{display:block;max-width:100%} a{color:inherit}
    .wrap{max-width:1120px;margin:auto;padding:0 22px}
    header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:80;background:rgba(7,37,63,.88);color:#fff;backdrop-filter:blur(12px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(12px);box-shadow:0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.18);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
    nav{min-height:74px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px}
    .brand-lockup{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;text-decoration:none;color:#fff}
    .brand-mark{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--teal),var(--teal2));color:#08334d;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.04em;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 12px;line-height:1;font-size:.98rem;box-shadow:0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
    .brand{font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:1.1rem;line-height:1}.brand span{color:var(--teal)}
    .brand-note{display:block;font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#bcecf2;margin-top:4px;font-weight:700}
    .nav-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px}
    nav ul{display:flex;gap:10px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;font-size:.9rem}.nav-links a{text-decoration:none;display:block;padding:9px 12px;border-radius:999px;color:#e8f2f6;font-weight:700}.nav-links a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
    .nav-cta{text-decoration:none;display:inline-block;padding:10px 16px;border-radius:999px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--teal),var(--teal2));color:#062c3c;font-weight:900;box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
    .hero{background:radial-gradient(circle at top left,rgba(98,219,230,.18),transparent 28%),linear-gradient(120deg,var(--navy2) 0%,var(--navy) 62%,#0d4b74 100%);color:#fff;overflow:hidden}
    .hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.02fr .98fr;align-items:stretch;min-height:600px}
    .hero-copy{padding:82px 34px 68px 0;align-self:center}
    .eyebrow{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.16em;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:800;color:#baf4f7}
    h1{font-size:clamp(3.1rem,6vw,5.3rem);line-height:.92;letter-spacing:-.04em;margin:14px 0 14px}
    h1 span{display:block;color:var(--teal)}
    .hero-copy p{font-size:1.16rem;max-width:640px;color:#e7f3f6;margin:0 0 24px}
    .strap{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);padding:12px 16px;border-radius:999px;font-size:1rem;color:#fff;margin:0 0 24px;font-style:normal;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.05em;text-transform:uppercase}
    .hero-highlights{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 26px}.hero-highlights span{display:inline-block;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.1);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);font-size:.86rem;font-weight:700;color:#dff9fb}
    .buttons{display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.btn{display:inline-block;padding:12px 18px;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800;border:2px solid transparent;transition:transform .18s ease, box-shadow .18s ease}
    .btn:hover{transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 10px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
    .primary{background:var(--teal);color:#062c3c}.secondary{border-color:#d3f3f6;color:#fff}
    .hero-photo{position:relative;min-height:600px;background:#ddd;padding:28px 0 28px 28px}.hero-photo .frame{position:relative;height:100%;border-radius:28px 0 0 28px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}.hero-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 38%}
    .hero-photo .frame:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(7,55,95,.18),transparent 32%)}
    .quickbar{background:#fff;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
    .quickgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:0}.quick{padding:18px;text-align:center;border-right:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:800;color:var(--navy)}.quick:last-child{border-right:none}.quick small{display:block;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;margin-top:2px}
    section{padding:64px 0}.white{background:#fff}.cream{background:var(--cream)}
    .section-kicker{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.15em;font-size:.75rem;font-weight:800;color:#1a98a7;margin-bottom:8px}
    h2{font-size:clamp(2rem,4vw,3.2rem);line-height:1.03;letter-spacing:-.035em;margin:0 0 14px;color:var(--navy)}
    .lead{font-size:1.08rem;color:var(--muted);max-width:830px;margin:0 0 28px}
    .split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:34px;align-items:center}
    .story p{margin:0 0 16px}.story strong{color:var(--navy)}
    .photo-card{background:#fff;padding:10px;border:1px solid #dedede;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.08);transform:rotate(.8deg)}
    .photo-card img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;object-fit:cover}.caption{font-size:.8rem;color:#687781;padding:8px 5px 2px}
    .quote{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:1.45rem;line-height:1.4;color:var(--navy);border-left:5px solid var(--teal);padding:18px 22px;background:var(--soft);border-radius:8px}
    .ideas{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}.idea{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:14px;padding:18px 20px}.idea h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:1rem;color:var(--navy)}.idea p{margin:0;color:#536a79;font-size:.94rem}
    .gallery{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;gap:14px}.gallery img{width:100%;height:270px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:14px}.gallery img:nth-child(2){object-position:center 32%}
    .newsbox{background:#fff;border:1px solid #d8d0c4;border-radius:4px;padding:28px;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
    .masthead{text-align:center;font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,5vw,3rem);border-top:5px solid #1b1b1b;border-bottom:2px solid #1b1b1b;padding:10px 0;margin-bottom:18px;color:#111}
    .newsgrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:24px}.newsgrid h3{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:1.6rem;line-height:1.05;margin:0 0 12px;color:#1a1a1a}.newsgrid p{margin:0 0 12px;color:#333}.paper-thumb{border:1px solid #bbb;background:#fff;padding:7px}.paper-thumb img{width:100%}
    .eventstrip{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:34px;border-radius:18px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:20px}.eventstrip h3{font-size:1.55rem;margin:0 0 6px}.eventstrip p{margin:0;color:#d8ebf2}.eventstrip .btn{white-space:nowrap}
    .vote{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:24px}.vote-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px}.vote-card h3{margin:0 0 9px;color:var(--navy)}.vote-card ul{margin:8px 0 0;padding-left:20px}.vote-card li{margin:6px 0}
    .contact{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),#0e4d73);color:#fff;border-radius:20px;padding:34px;text-align:center}.contact h2{color:#fff}.contact p{color:#dbeaf0}.contact a{font-weight:800;color:#fff}
    footer{background:#061f35;color:#d9e8ef;padding:28px 0;font-size:.88rem}.legal{font-size:.76rem;color:#a9bfca;margin-top:9px}
    .small{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--muted)}
    @media(max-width:820px){
      .nav-links,.nav-cta{display:none}.hero-grid,.split,.newsgrid,.vote{grid-template-columns:1fr}.hero-copy{padding:54px 0 38px}.hero-photo{min-height:430px;padding:0 0 24px}.hero-photo .frame{border-radius:22px}.hero-grid{min-height:auto}.quickgrid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.quick:nth-child(2){border-right:none}.ideas{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr}.gallery img{height:auto}.eventstrip{grid-template-columns:1fr}.eventstrip .btn{justify-self:start}
    }
  
    .events-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:28px}
    .event-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(7,55,95,.08)}
    .event-card img{width:100%;height:205px;object-fit:cover;background:#f4f6f7}
    .event-card.event-screenshot img{object-fit:contain;padding:10px;background:#f6f6f6}
    .event-card .body{padding:18px}
    .event-date{display:inline-block;background:var(--teal);color:#063145;font-weight:900;border-radius:999px;padding:6px 10px;font-size:.78rem;margin-bottom:10px}
    .event-card h3{margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--navy);font-size:1.25rem;line-height:1.12}
    .event-card p{margin:4px 0;color:var(--muted)}
    .event-card .event-time{font-weight:800;color:var(--ink)}
    .event-note{margin-top:26px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:18px 22px;border-radius:16px}
    .event-note strong{color:var(--teal2)}
    .story-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:18px;margin-top:28px}
    .story-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden}
    .story-card img{width:100%;height:330px;object-fit:cover}
    .story-card .caption{padding:16px 18px}
    .story-card h3{margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--navy);font-size:1.18rem}
    .story-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted)}
    .recent-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px;margin-top:26px}
    .recent-card{background:#fff;border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--line)}
    .recent-card img{width:100%;height:260px;object-fit:cover}
    .recent-card .caption{padding:12px 14px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy)}
    @media(max-width:820px){.events-grid,.story-grid,.recent-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.event-card img{height:auto;max-height:330px}.story-card img,.recent-card img{height:auto;max-height:420px}}

.site-banner{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#062c4c 0%,#07253c 100%);padding:28px 0 16px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);position:relative;overflow:hidden}.site-banner:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -8% -35% auto;width:320px;height:320px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(41,191,208,.25),transparent 65%)}
.site-banner .wrap{display:flex;justify-content:center}
.site-banner img{display:block;width:min(100%,1120px);height:auto;border-radius:22px;box-shadow:0 20px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.26);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
@media (max-width:760px){.site-banner{padding:16px 0 10px}.site-banner img{border-radius:14px}}

    .events-feature{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#072d52 0%,#0b456c 100%);color:#fff;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
    .events-feature:before{content:"";position:absolute;width:430px;height:430px;border-radius:50%;right:-160px;top:-220px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(41,191,208,.30),transparent 68%)}
    .events-feature .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1}
    .events-feature .section-kicker{color:#77e4ec;font-size:.82rem}
    .events-feature h2{color:#fff;font-size:clamp(2.35rem,4.5vw,3.65rem);max-width:760px}
    .events-feature > .wrap > p{color:#dceef3;font-size:1.08rem;max-width:790px;margin-bottom:8px}
    .events-feature .events-grid{margin-top:34px;gap:22px}
    .events-feature .event-card{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.20);box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.20);transform:translateY(0);transition:transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease}
    .events-feature .event-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 24px 46px rgba(0,0,0,.26)}
    .events-feature .event-card .body{padding:20px}
    .events-feature .event-date{font-size:.82rem;padding:7px 12px}
    .events-feature .event-card h3{font-size:1.34rem}
    .events-feature .event-note{background:rgba(255,255,255,.10);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15)}

</style>
</head>

<header><div class="wrap"><nav>

</nav></div></header>

<main>
<section class="hero">
<div class="wrap hero-grid">
<div class="hero-copy">
<div class="eyebrow">Candidate for Waterford Board of Education</div>
<h1>Listening Comes <span>Before Leading</span></h1>
<p>Waterford graduate. Local Realtor. Small business owner. Community advocate. Mom of three Waterford students.</p>
<div class="buttons"><a class="btn primary" href="#meet">Meet Kelly</a><a class="btn secondary" href="#events">Upcoming events</a></div>
</div>
